title: Hosted API congestion: fallback fast-paths and eviction-policy rewrite
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: On 2025-02-08 we observed a hosted-api capacity exhaustion event that manifested as long queues and elevated 5xxs for ~42 minutes. Root cause analysis identified an interaction between a recent autoscaler heuristic change (aggressively prefilling GPU pools on small-percentage load patterns) and a model-serving admission regression that allowed large fan-out requests into warm pools. This caused rapid KV cache amplification plus sustained token-level saturation of a subset of GPU hosts, preventing normal autoscale priming and resulting in request throttling and cascading backpressure across the region.

Impact: Multiple production tenants experienced >500ms p50 latency regressions and transient 429/503 responses. Some background batch jobs were evicted; no customer data loss. Estimates: ~120k tokens dropped during the event window, peak queued requests 18k.

Scope of this ticket: implement short-to-medium term mitigations and durable fixes driven from the incident postmortem, including: safer autoscaler defaults, admission gating fast-paths, eviction-policy rewrite to prefer tenant fair-share and short-lived prefills, automated capacity priming playbook, improved telemetry and alerting, and a test harness for regression prevention.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New admission gate reduces median queue length by >= 40% in synthetic congestion tests; 2) Eviction policy ensures no single-tenant fanout can monopolize >20% of a GPU pool under load; 3) Autoscaler heuristic rollbacks behind feature flag with safe default enabled; 4) Playbook steps added to runbook and validated in a tabletop drill; 5) Dashboards and alerts produce <1 minute noisy-alert window and include circuit-breaker health metric.
action_items: A1: Revert autoscaler heuristic change to conservative prefill (feature-flagged) — OWNER: Liam — ETA: 2025-02-18 (PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1228)

A2: Implement admission gating fast-path: reject requests exceeding per-tenant parallelism threshold with soft-fail fallback to lower-cost model variant — OWNER: Priya Rao — ETA: 2025-02-28 (RFC: confluence.redwood.ai/adm-gate)

A3: Rewrite eviction policy to tenant fair-share + age bias, add short-lived prefills exemption for warmup-only tokens — OWNER: Marco Silva — ETA: 2025-03-05 (PR: github.com/redwood/serving/pull/4312)
A4: Add capacity-priming automation: prewarm pools on predicted load windows using traffic forecast and recent trend — OWNER: Data Platform — ETA: 2025-03-12 (runbook: kb.redwood.ai/priming)
A5: Add observability: per-pool tenant-occupancy heatmap, queue-lifetime histogram, admission-reject-rate alert — OWNER: Observability — ETA: 2025-02-22 (dashboard: grafana.redwood.ai/d/queue-health)
A6: Backfill incident postmortem notes into postmortems repo and notify customers impacted — OWNER: Aisha — ETA: 2025-02-14 (incident doc: drive.redwood.ai/incident-2025-02-08)
A7: Create chaos/regression test that simulates KV amplification and verifies fair-eviction correctness — OWNER: SRE — ETA: 2025-03-01 (test harness: github.com/redwood/tests/tree/eviction-fuzz)
A8: Add canary gates for rollout and a rollback playbook for faster revert — OWNER: Release Engineering — ETA: 2025-02-20
